title: Backwards Caption Repair
brief: A legacy captioning service stored every subtitle line with its words in backwards order, and its output is littered with extra spaces. Before re-publishing, we need to repair each line.
Implement restoreCaptionOrder(s), where s is the stored caption line, and return a string with the words in the opposite order, separated by exactly one space.
